study: Gas CO and Superconductivity case studies

dataset_splits.gas: 2011-2013 train; 2014-2015 test; 9 predictors, exclude year and both emissions targets
dataset_splits.superconductivity: GroupShuffleSplit(test_size=0.2,random_state=0), connected groups joining identical supplied elemental compositions OR identical 81-predictor vectors; all rows retained

preprocessing: float64; train-only population mean/std of predictors and target, explicit intercept; all rows retained; no whitening
control: existing common reweighting on D-optimal support at primary budget
analysis: Descriptive summaries by task and budget; means, standard deviations and ranges across all stochastic runs.
verification: Independent reconstruction of saved selected fits and QR cross-checks of full fits and numerical recovery.
